dedupe_keys.name: aquacrop jl julia implementation of the aquacrop process based crop growth model

description: AquaCrop.jl is a Julia package implementing AquaCrop, the FAO process-based model of crop growth driven by water availability. The Zenodo record for version 1.0.0 (25 May 2025) lists its changelog: the package became ready to install and use, with fixes to the harvest and crop field setup functions, documentation of outputs, and suggestions from its Journal of Open Source Software review, and the package was registered. It was released by Gabriel Diaz Iturry, Marco Matthies and Guy Pe'er of the Helmholtz Centre for Environmental Research and Daniel Vedder of the German Centre for Integrative Biodiversity Research (iDiv) as a downloadable source ZIP of about 0.3 MB under a BSD-3 licence. Coverage is any field with weather, soil and crop inputs. Caveats: the record does not state which AquaCrop version it reproduces or how it was validated. For simulation it lets AquaCrop run inside Julia workflows, for example coupled with agent-based farm models or large ensembles for drought and irrigation scenarios. A related catalogue record is AquaCrop, the FAO crop water productivity model.
